english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese word for an automobile.

exampleSentences.english: I drive a car to work in the morning.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 zaa1 ce1 faan1 gung1

english.note: Use 車 as the all-purpose spoken noun for a conveyance or vehicle.

exampleSentences.english: This vehicle can carry the whole family.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢架車可以載晒成家人。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 ce1 ho2 ji5 zoi3 saai3 sing4 gaa1 jan4

english.note: Use 車 for the vehicle itself when ride means a car or other vehicle in casual speech.

exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 gaa3 ce1 gei2 leng3 wo3
